newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly sees Q1 net exceeding estimates.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly sees Q1 net exceeding estimates.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Wednesday its earnings for its first fiscal quarter ended September 28 will be $0.17 to $0.23 a share, exceeding analysts' expectations for the period.
Current analysts' expectations for the quarter generally range from break-even to $0.10 a share, Donnelly said.

The company, which supplies the automotive industry with fabricated, molded and coated glass products, said the primary reasons for the higher-than-expected earnings are stronger operational performance in its North American operations and higher-than-expected sales.
